# Tables {#sec-g-tables}

```{r}
#| include: false
source("../_setup.R")
sc <- synth_counts(n_per_group = 4)
fdr <- report_param("fdr")
lfc <- report_param("lfc_threshold")
kept <- rowMeans(sc$counts) >= report_param("min_count")
de <- synth_de(n_per_group = 4)[kept, ]
de$FDR <- p.adjust(de$p, method = "BH")
de$passed <- de$FDR < fdr & abs(de$log2FC) >= lfc
de$direction <- ifelse(!de$passed, "did not pass", ifelse(de$log2FC > 0, "rose", "fell"))
truth <- sc$truth[kept, ]
```

Every table has a label and a caption. Numbers are formatted by helpers, and every share carries its denominator.

## A computed table {#sec-g-tables-kable}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-g-tables-top
#| tbl-cap: "The ten synthetic features with the smallest p-values, with log2 fold change, p-value, and FDR."
top <- head(de[order(de$p), c("gene", "log2FC", "p", "FDR")], 10)
top$log2FC <- round(top$log2FC, 2)
top$p <- signif(top$p, 2)
top$FDR <- signif(top$FDR, 2)
knitr::kable(top, row.names = FALSE, col.names = c("Feature", "log2 fold change", "p", "FDR"))
```

## A paged table {#sec-g-tables-paged}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-g-tables-paged
#| tbl-cap: "Every tested synthetic feature, ten rows per page. Use the arrows to page through."
de[, c("gene", "log2FC", "p", "FDR", "direction")]
```

With `df-print: paged` set in `_quarto.yml`, a printed data frame becomes a paged table. Use it for any table longer than about 20 rows.

## Numbers with their denominators {#sec-g-tables-frac}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-g-tables-frac
#| tbl-cap: "Tested features by call, as counts with thousands separators and as shares of the features tested."
calls <- table(factor(de$direction, levels = c("rose", "fell", "did not pass")))
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Call = names(calls),
  Features = fmt(as.integer(calls)),
  Share = vapply(as.integer(calls), function(k) frac(k, nrow(de)), character(1))
))
```

`fmt()` adds thousands separators. `frac()` writes "k of n (p%)", so no percentage appears without its denominator.

## Cells that cannot have a value {#sec-g-tables-na}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-g-tables-na
#| tbl-cap: "Summary per group. A fold change against the control group cannot be computed for the control group itself."
lib <- colSums(sc$counts)
logcpm <- log2(t(t(sc$counts + 1) / (lib + 1) * 1e6))[kept, ]
treated <- sc$samples$group == "treated"
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Group = c("control", "treated"),
  Samples = c(sum(!treated), sum(treated)),
  `Median depth` = fmt(c(median(lib[!treated]), median(lib[treated]))),
  `Features past both thresholds against control` = c("not applicable", fmt(sum(de$passed))),
  check.names = FALSE
))
```

The control row reads "not applicable", not 0. A 0 would claim that a comparison was made and found nothing. No comparison of the control group with itself was made.

## The split by direction and subset {#sec-g-tables-split}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-g-tables-split
#| tbl-cap: "Features passing both thresholds, split by direction and by expression tier (thirds of mean log CPM)."
tier <- cut(rowMeans(logcpm), quantile(rowMeans(logcpm), c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1)),
            labels = c("low", "middle", "high"), include.lowest = TRUE)
split_tab <- table(factor(tier, levels = c("low", "middle", "high")),
                   factor(de$direction, levels = c("rose", "fell", "did not pass")))
knitr::kable(as.data.frame.matrix(split_tab))
```

## Recovery of the planted changes {#sec-g-tables-truth}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-g-tables-truth
#| tbl-cap: "Planted changes against calls, for the tested synthetic features. The data were simulated, so the truth is known."
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Truth = c("planted change", "no planted change"),
  `Passed both thresholds` = c(sum(truth$planted & de$passed), sum(!truth$planted & de$passed)),
  `Did not pass` = c(sum(truth$planted & !de$passed), sum(!truth$planted & !de$passed)),
  check.names = FALSE
))
```

Of `r fmt(sum(truth$planted))` planted changes among tested features, `r frac(sum(truth$planted & de$passed), sum(truth$planted))` passed both thresholds. Of the `r fmt(sum(de$passed))` features that passed, `r fmt(sum(!truth$planted & de$passed))` had no planted change.
